_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
Backup before updating recommended. On first start PokéCollect adds new columns and tables (regulation marks, sorting, friends, shared collections) and then fills in the regulation marks of your cards in the background. Existing data is not rewritten.

• New: multiple users with their own cards, collections, wishlist and settings; sign-in also via SSO (e.g. Authentik). Admins manage users and server settings in the new admin portal.
• New: friends — add them by exact username and share single collections to view. Friends see condition, language and value, not your purchase prices or notes. Collections shared with you are on the Collections page.
• New: image-recognition scanner with a candidate picker, card outline, multiple copies, Play! stamp (Prize Pack) and scanning straight into an empty binder pocket. Confirmed scans improve recognition; admins can export them as a dataset and see which photos are missing there.
• New: tournament legality — regulation mark per card, a Standard filter and the reprint rule (same name and same card text).
• New: find the right card — pick it from the catalog, or take the card image from pokemon.com by pasting a link or using Share on Android.
• New: sort by regulation mark; every sort can be reversed, and the previous sort becomes the sub-sort.
• New: English and US dollars — interface, set and card names in English, TCGplayer prices first.
• New: fill the Pokédex with placeholders for every species.
• Changed: Collections is the home page; the Pokédex moved to /pokedex. The header shows every page and the ☰ menu only appears when the window is narrow. The bottom bar shows every page and remembers hidden ones in your account.
• Changed: Settings only holds your personal options; everything for the whole server is in the admin portal.
• Changed: each card can switch between the catalog image and your own photo; when TCGdex has no image, pokemon.com steps in.
• Changed: after an update the app loads the new version by itself — when you return to it or on the next page change.
• Fixed: the binder size slider could only be made smaller. Short outages of an image source left broken images; they are now retried and replaced by a fallback. The set picker stayed empty for some sets.
• Note: with SSO, admins are the users listed in OIDC_ADMIN_USERS, members of the OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP group, or users an admin promotes in the admin portal.
title: Multiple users, friends and a new scanner
